title: Operation observation is lifecycle events with a closed metric label set
decision:
- One `OperationObserver` receives typed `started`, `completed` and `failed`
  events. All carry one immutable `OperationContext`; terminal events additionally
  carry duration and outcome/failure descriptor.
- Context contains operation id, correlation/causation, account/workspace refs,
  actor type/id, package, operation and non-negative attempt number.
- Adapters never receive a raw `Throwable`. Failure observation exposes only stable
  code/category/retryability/path; descriptor `details` and exception messages are
  not copied into logs, spans or metrics.
- Metric dimensions are exactly `package`, `operation`, `outcome`, `category`,
  `retry_bucket`. Unknown dimensions are rejected. Account, workspace, actor,
  correlation, causation and operation ids are log/trace fields only.
- Retry bucket is `0`, `1`, `2-3`, `4+`; exact attempts remain structured context.
rationale:
Events keep core vendor-neutral and testable. A closed dimension set makes the
cardinality promise executable; relying on reviewer discipline would not.

sections.title: D62 — Operation observation is lifecycle events with a closed metric label set
sections.text:
**Actor:** plan-designer/codex-gpt-5.6-sol/high
**Evidence:** RAG:— no common long-operation seam exists. RAG:✅ PSR-3 supports
structured context with static messages; OpenTelemetry requires bounded metric
attributes and gives logs dedicated trace/span correlation fields.

sections.title: Решение
sections.text:
- One `OperationObserver` receives typed `started`, `completed` and `failed`
  events. All carry one immutable `OperationContext`; terminal events additionally

- Metric dimensions are exactly `package`, `operation`, `outcome`, `category`,

- Retry bucket is `0`, `1`, `2-3`, `4+`; exact attempts remain structured context.

sections.title: Почему
sections.text:
Events keep core vendor-neutral and testable. A closed dimension set makes the
cardinality promise executable; relying on reviewer discipline would not.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.text:
P12.4 supplies null and PSR-3 adapters. P12.5 reuses the exact event contract for
OpenTelemetry and must prove a forbidden identifier label fails before export.
